plan: Given my value of $20, I should aim to win while minimizing payment. Bidding exactly $20 ensures I win if others bid lower. Bids above $20 are dominated since I can't profit more than my value. Bidding slightly below $20 risks losing if others bid close to $20. Thus, bidding $20 maximizes my chance of winning without overpaying, ensuring the highest possible profit given my value.

My value for the item is $24, which is above the maximum possible value of $20. I should bid slightly above $20 to maximize my chances of winning while minimizing my payment. Bidding $20.1 ensures I win against any bid at or below the maximum value of $20. This strategy is optimal since it guarantees a win and a profit, as my value exceeds all possible bids and I will pay the second-highest bid.

My value for the prize is $18. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive payoff if I win. A bid of $17.9 can help win against bids below $17.9 while still ensuring a profit if the second-highest bid is lower. Bids above $18 are dominated as they ensure a loss.
